dialogue.txt: = !DRAGON BALL Z: GERO'S LEGACY ... Years ago, deep inside a Red Ribbon Army bunker...
= !Dr. Gero swore that the boy called Goku would pay for everything he had taken from him.
= Red Ribbon Army Headquarters. Deep beneath the command tower, the army's chief scientist was still at work.
= The drone's targeting array is drifting again...
= Father! You haven't left this lab in three days. Commander Red wants the drone report by morning.
= Then Commander Red will have it by morning, Gevo. Perfection takes time. The army can wait one more night.
= The army can't wait. My squad ships out to the Northern Wastelands at dawn.{p}They say some kid with a staff has been tearing through our outposts.
= A child? The Red Ribbon Army is afraid of a child?{p}Take two of my drones with you. I'll guide them from the command room myself.
= You and your machines... All right. But promise me you'll get some sleep.
= I'll sleep when my work is finished. Now go, Gevo. And come back in one piece.
= I always do. Don't forget the {c07}drone terminal{c02} before you head up to the command room.
= Hmph. Always telling me what to do... just like his mother.
= These old legs... I'd better hurry if I'm going to catch the squad on the monitors.
= Go on, Father. The terminal won't check itself.
= LAB TECHNICIAN: The drones are calibrated, Doctor. Well... almost. The targeting array still drifts three degrees.
